GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2023-10-18T09:07:00Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: The result of Array slice calculation does not match that of direct calculation with date type bfloat16
Description: ### Description

```np.random.seed(13)
w = np.random.randn(2048, 2048).astype(np.float32)
x = np.random.randn(2048, 2048).astype(np.float32)

res1 = jnp.asarray(x, dtype=jnp.bfloat16) @ jnp.asarray(w, dtype=jnp.bfloat16)
res2 = jnp.asarray(x[0:1,:], dtype=jnp.bfloat16) @ jnp.asarray(w, dtype=jnp.bfloat16)
error = jnp.max(jnp.abs(res1[0:1,:] - res2))
print(f"Max error: {error} ") 

#The error is 0.25 and will increase with the increase of matrix size.
```
Maybe it's due to ```bfloat32``` precision? But they have the same date type and the same operation ```@``` , I wonder why the results are inconsistent. Looking forward to your answer, thanks.
